children.name: Hint
children.text: Arrows choose · E go to the room · Esc back

children.name: how.walk.words
children.text: The arrow keys or W A S D walk one bed at a time, along the paths. Hold Shift to turn on the spot.

children.name: how.lamp.words
children.text: E lights or douses the lamp beside you. A gold mark shows which one.

children.name: how.moonbloom.words
children.text: A moonbloom rises while its bed is lit and sinks in the dark. Stand on one to ride it.

children.name: how.duskcap.words
children.text: A duskcap rises in the dark and sinks in light.

children.name: how.crate.words
children.text: Walk into a crate to push it. A risen bloom or a tall screen casts a shadow.

children.name: how.exit.words
children.text: The green ring is the way out. R starts the room again. Fireflies are for the curious.

children.name: Hint
children.text: E change the chosen control, then press the new key · Esc back

children.name: end.line
children.text: Every bed is tended and every lamp has had its turn. Thank you for walking the garden.
